name: Undervoice
description: A throat that sings under itself: an octave, a twelfth or two octaves below the key, down to single slow pulses that fall like tuned drips.

params.name: Division
params.description: How many pulses the false folds count before they open again: two is an octave below, three a twelfth. Drips counts very many. Shared fits one slow pulse to all keys.

params.name: Second division
params.description: The other count of pulses the voice can sing with. One is the open voice with nothing under it. Turn and Breath say when it is heard.

params.name: Turn
params.description: How far the voice goes over to its second division and back by turns, like a door. At zero it keeps to the first.

params.name: Breath
params.description: How deeply the whole chord breathes: loud and full on the way out, quiet, dark and airy on the second division on the way in.

params.name: Pace
params.description: How often the voice turns from one division to the other and back, and how quickly it breathes.

params.name: Depth
params.description: How far the false folds shut between the pulses they let through. At zero there is nothing under the voice, at the top only short bursts of it are left.

params.name: Closure
params.description: How hard the folds meet. Low is soft and round, high is tight, bright and brassy. A harder touch brightens in the same way.

params.name: Skew
params.description: How each group of pulses opens. Low is struck, bright and falls away, the middle opens and shuts evenly, high swells dark and is cut off.

params.name: Ring
params.description: How long each pulse rings on at the harmonics of the key. Low is dry and creaking, high turns sparse pulses into tuned drops and the voice into a smooth tone.

params.name: Vowel
params.description: The shape of the mouth, from Oo through Oh, Ah, Eh and Ee to a rounded Ue.

params.name: Mouth
params.description: How far the mouth is open, from a closed hum through a covered tone to wide and clear.

params.name: Throat
params.description: The size of the throat. Low is a long dark throat, high a small one with its vowels far up.

params.name: Chest
params.description: How much the chest sounds: warm low modes under the voice, and a floor tuned to the undertone of each key or to its octave.

params.name: Whisper
params.description: Air through the folds. High is nearly all breath, shaped by the vowel, the gate and the rings of the key.

params.name: Roughness
params.description: How uneven the pulses and their groups are in strength and time, from a clean tone to a bright growl.

params.name: Drift
params.description: How far the singers wander from the note and from each other, and how much the vowel and the mouth move by themselves.

params.name: Singers
params.description: How many voices sing each key, a little apart in pitch and place.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long a note takes to swell in.

params.name: Fade
params.description: How long a held note takes to die away. In the upper part of the range it keeps more and more of itself, and at the top it holds.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long a note takes to fade once the key is let go. The rings end with it.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far apart the keys of a chord, their singers and their rings stand. At zero everything is in the middle.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Overall output level of the instrument.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. Each key is a pulse train gated by a second, slower closure that counts whole cycles of the key, as the false folds of a singing throat do, through a shared throat of six parallel formants with six chest modes beside it and eight tuned resonators a key. Vowel places are the ones commonly measured for sung vowels; the rest is voiced by measurement and is not a model of any one singer.
